newsitem.title: UK: NWE physical gas oil firmer, but heat off in August.
newsitem.headline: NWE physical gas oil firmer, but heat off in August.

text.p: NWE gas oil prices were firmer in quiet trade on Tuesday.
The market tracked benchmark IPE gas oil as premiums for spot barges and cargoes held steady, traders said.
Tight nearby supply held barge and cargo premiums to futures steady, but talk of growing supplies weakened early August premiums for heating oil a little.

Premiums for prompt 0.2 sulphur cargoes held steady around August IPE $$1.50/+$2.50 a tonne cif NWE. But the recent contango on premiums to early August has turned into a small backwardation with a healthier supply seen from Ventspils.
Around five Russian cargo are scheduled to load by July 25 shipping sources said.
Diesel cargo premiums were holding firm after a flurry of trade on Monday. Most of the business was for August delivery but a prompt cargo was sold into Bordeaux at around Aug IPE +$3.50 a tonne.
Prompt deliveries basis Le Havre and ARA valued August IPE +$4.50 a tonne.
Flushing diesel barges were traded a couple of times at August IPE +$4 a tonne fob with Rotterdam liftings traded at August IPE +$5 a tonne.

Heating oil barge trade was quiet. Traders said that with the firmer dollar stifling demand from Germany and loading delays in Rotterdam meaning many players would be getting oil later than expected, most interest was focused on early August liftings.
Brokers said the loading delays at the jointly owned BP, Texaco Nerefco refinery in Rotterdam have been caused by hefty nominations for loading on the 16th.
"Some of the barges have been given deferred loading dates in order to avoid demurrage costs but all will get there oil," a broker said.

Prompt barges talked steady around August IPE +$1/+$1.50 fob ARA with early August premiums 25 to 50 cents firmer at August IPE +75 cents to +$1 per tonne fob ARA with second half August liftings around August IPE +50 cents/+$1.
